verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Payments/Checkout product documents webhooks to "track the status of payments and order lifecycle events" (crossmint-docs-42, crossmint-docs-18), so a backend can receive pushed order events for checkout orders. However, the agent-facing Agent Checkouts product explicitly has "no webhooks in v1" and requires polling until a terminal state (crossmint-supp-7), so agent order flows lack push delivery. Missing for 10: push events for Agent Checkouts orders, a documented event catalog covering created/updated/fulfilled/canceled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
